title: stackfoundry settings (.stackfoundry/config.json)
description: The repo's stackfoundry settings, shared by every assistant and collaborator. Written by init; read with `stackfoundry config [key]`, which fills in the defaults. A missing file means all defaults.

clients.description: The assistants this repo uses. init and sync write each one's files (rulebooks, instruction block, generated skills and agents); the rest are left alone.

docsRoot.description: Folder, relative to the repo root, where trackers live (bug reports, test designs, plans, specifications, dependency and radar reports).

researchRefreshDays.description: A technology pack older than this is flagged stale by tech-radar and offered for re-research.

defaultEffort.description: How wide orchestrators fan out when the request does not say: quick (diff scope, one verify vote), standard, or thorough (deep sweep, three refutation votes on high-risk findings).
